item.title: Show HN: I have tried using Honestify instead of sending direct CV/Resume
item.summary: Now a days, I am sending my AI profile to recruiters who are reaching out to me on LinkedIn instead of sharing just one page resume. Only few seems to be receptive of this. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49317091 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
